(1) The relational UPDATE 1 operation is translated to the OO UPDATE operation; (2) The INSERT operation is translated to an OO INSERT operation followed by an OO UPDATE operation; and (3) The DELETE operation is translated to a DELETE operation in OO.

the relational database update operations can be mapped to their OO correspondences, which include UPDATE, INSERT and DELET operations, and the object migration problem is solved by the use of the object migration table.

relational update operations are mapped to OO update operations in the following way: (1) UPDATE operation is translated into UPDATE, INSERT and/or DELETE; (2) INSERT operation is translated into INSERT; (3) DELETE operation is translated into DELETE.
